About.paragraphOne: I'm a {role} with {years} years of experience building scalable web platforms and backend systems. I currently work in financial technology, where I integrate payment providers, maintain the core financial backend and its REST APIs, and take applications all the way to production on cloud infrastructure.
About.paragraphThree: I work with AI agents every day Claude Code and Antigravity and I treat what they produce like any other contribution: it goes through the same specification, the same tests and the same review before it ships. I'm based in {location} and I work in English and Spanish.
About.paragraphTwo: My day to day is React, Next.js, PHP and Laravel, with a relational database underneath. What I optimize for is data integrity, database performance, and an architecture the next developer can pick up without me in the room.
About.title: About me

Skills.aiIntro: AI agents are part of my daily workflow. They are not a shortcut around engineering the specification, the tests and the review stay exactly where they were.
Skills.aiPracticeOne: <term>Spec before code</term> I write down what has to be true before an agent touches the repository, so the output can be judged instead of trusted.
Skills.aiPracticeThree: <term>Review on every diff</term> I read every line that goes in. Agents parallelise the work; they do not take over the responsibility.
Skills.aiPracticeTwo: <term>Tests as the contract</term> Automated tests decide whether a change ships. That rule does not change depending on who, or what, wrote it.
Skills.aiTooling: Day to day: Claude Code, Antigravity, and splitting larger jobs across parallel agents when the work genuinely divides.
